flows.label: Pre-visit
flows.description: Ticket holders before they arrive. Triggered off the ACME visit date.

paths.name: VISIT: T-30 Plan Ahead

trigger.label: 30 days before the Acme - Visit Date (Next)

paths.action: For the 16% who book more than a month out: a checklist (lodging, evenings and seasonal attractions, the drive, a park day), their visit day with a link to that day's hours, winter road advice, the premiere preview and two short gallery and boardwalk videos, and the membership offer or a member thank-you.
paths.split: Active Members (ACME field: active or new) segment

paths.name: VISIT: T-3 Pre-Visit Excitement

trigger.label: 3 days before the Acme - Visit Date (Next)

paths.action: The entry window, a bring / leave-in-the-car table, parking, the live Medora weather card, making a day of it with the national park, the Trailblazer video, and a member welcome or the ticket-to-membership offer at the Welcome Desk.
paths.split: Active Members (ACME field: active or new) segment: members get the member email, everyone else the non-member email

paths.name: VISIT: T-24h Trailblazer

trigger.label: 1 day before the Acme - Visit Date (Next)

paths.action: Send one email asking the visitor to pre-register their Trailblazer wristband (link carries their ACME order ID).

emails.subject: Do this tonight to speed up your arrival experience
emails.preheader: Set up your Trailblazer wristband before you arrive at the Library.

paths.name: VISIT: T+1 Welcome

trigger.label: 1 day after the Acme - Last Purchase Date

paths.action: Sent the day after tickets are bought, once the overnight ACME sync has landed: the 3½-minute Library preview, the four things that are hard to plan in Medora (where to stay, getting here, planning the days, the national park), nearest airports and One Medora packages. Members are thanked; everyone else is offered membership with their ticket cost applied and their reservation kept.
paths.split: Active Members (ACME field: active or new) segment

flows.label: Post-visit
flows.description: Follow-up after the visit: shop, stay connected, private events, what's next.

paths.name: VISIT: T+2 Thank You

trigger.label: 2 days after the Acme - Visit Date (Next)

paths.action: Thanks for coming, a reminder that the Trailblazer journal and photos stay online for 30 days, and the newsletter topics (From the Archive, The Badlands, Events & Programs and five more) so they choose what arrives. Members are thanked; everyone else sees the membership levels.
paths.split: Active Members (ACME field: active or new) segment

paths.name: VISIT: T+7 Keep Exploring

trigger.label: 7 days after the Acme - Visit Date (Next)

paths.action: T.R.'s life online (the Badlands chapter and Conservation), two quizzes (Fact or Fiction and the Animals of the Badlands family edition) and the Good Citizen podcast with its Live from the TRPL series.
paths.split: Active Members (ACME field: active or new) segment

paths.name: VISIT: T+14 From the Shop

trigger.label: 14 days after the Acme - Visit Date (Next)

paths.action: The online Library Shop: the special-edition Filson backpack, the Bully! hat, the Arena quote tee and the journal set. Members are reminded their 10% discount works online, with their level named; everyone else is shown membership as a way to save 10%.
paths.split: Active Members (ACME field: active or new) segment

paths.name: VISIT: T+30 Host an Event

trigger.label: 30 days after the Acme - Visit Date (Next)

paths.action: Private events: weddings, corporate gatherings, private dinners for 12 to 60 and nonprofit convenings, with the spaces and catering look books and the inquiry form.
paths.split: Active Members (ACME field: active or new) segment

paths.name: VISIT: T+60 Reasons to Come Back

trigger.label: 60 days after the Acme - Visit Date (Next)

paths.action: Special events and specialty tours without naming any one event, a nudge to the Events & Programs topic, member perks for members and the membership levels for everyone else.
paths.split: Active Members (ACME field: active or new) segment

flows.label: Membership
flows.description: Turning ticket buyers into members, and keeping members renewing.

paths.name: RENEW: T-60 Renewal Notice

trigger.label: 60 days before the Acme - Membership Expiration Date

filters: Acme - Is Active Member is active
Acme - Subscription is blank or cancelled (not on auto-renew)
Acme - Membership Card Type is Primary
paths.action: First renewal notice, one email with conditional rows: Founding Members get a thank-you, permanent recognition on the Digital Donor Wall and an invitation to continue at Contributing; every other level sees its own renewal prices (1 year, auto-renew, 2 years), a nudge to the next level up, and a thank-you or visit invitation depending on their last ticket.

emails.subject: Two months left in your membership year
emails.preheader: Your level, your renewal options, and 10% off with auto-renew or two years.
notes: Conditional rows switch on Acme - Membership Level (Founding Membership, Individual, Dual, Family, Contributing, Patron, Donor Patron) and Acme - Ticket Type (Last) (Member Adult or Member Youth = visited as a member). Use the switches above the preview.
The expiration date prints from Acme - Membership Expiration (Text), written daily by sync_date_text.py (the date field itself can't print).
Founding Members: T-60 and T-30 ask them to continue at Contributing ($250). Dual or Family come in as the smaller, recovery option from T-7 on and in both lapsed emails.
Constant Contact dynamic content works on rows in the drag-and-drop editor, not in custom-code emails, so this one goes into Constant Contact as a drag-and-drop email when it is approved.
Audience rules from Katie (membership), 2026-10-20. ACME is the membership system of record, so every field in these emails is an Acme field; never DonorPerfect, which syncs days late.

Before going live, two ACME fields must be mapped to Constant Contact: Subscription (active / cancelled; blank or cancelled = not on auto-renew) and Membership Card Type (send only to Primary, the head of household who bought the membership; secondary card holders get no ACME emails).

Acme - Is Active Member: active = current member; new = a renewal (or downgrade) is already bought, so they are left out of the reminders; lapsed = expired (ACME switches the day after expiration); dropped = ended early at the member's request, never sent a renewal.
Confirm the Founding Member wording on the Digital Donor Wall with Development.
The Renew My Membership button URL is correct (Katie, 2026-10-20).

paths.name: RENEW: T-30 Reminder

trigger.label: 30 days before the Acme - Membership Expiration Date

filters: Acme - Is Active Member is active
Acme - Subscription is blank or cancelled (not on auto-renew)
Acme - Membership Card Type is Primary
paths.action: Full reminder, matching the first notice: the member's own price table, a visit thank-you or invitation, the next-level nudge and what renewing keeps; Founding Members are invited to continue at Contributing, with their permanent recognition.

emails.subject: One month left on your membership
emails.preheader: Renew by [[custom.acme_-_membership_expiration_text OR "your renewal date"]]: your level, your price, and 10% off with auto-renew or two years.
notes: Already renewed? ACME marks them new, so the active-only filter leaves them out (Katie, 2026-10-20).

paths.name: RENEW: T-7 Last Week

trigger.label: 7 days before the Acme - Membership Expiration Date

filters: Acme - Is Active Member is active
Acme - Subscription is blank or cancelled (not on auto-renew)
Acme - Membership Card Type is Primary
paths.action: Short last-week note with the member's own renewal price, signed by the membership team; Founding Members get Contributing first, with Dual or Family as the smaller option.

emails.subject: Your membership ends next week
emails.preheader: Your member benefits end on [[custom.acme_-_membership_expiration_text OR "your renewal date"]].

paths.name: RENEW: T+7 Membership Ended

trigger.label: 7 days after the Acme - Membership Expiration Date

filters: Acme - Is Active Member is lapsed
Acme - Subscription is blank or cancelled (not on auto-renew)
Acme - Membership Card Type is Primary
paths.action: Lapsed notice with the full sell: the member's own rejoin price table, a thank-you if they visited, the next-level nudge, what membership brings back and how to rejoin; Founding Members hear that their status and Digital Donor Wall name are permanent.

emails.subject: Your membership has ended
emails.preheader: Rejoin at your level and your free admission and member benefits come right back.
notes: Confirm with ACME that a lapsed member renews with the same membership number.

paths.name: RENEW: T+45 Last Note

trigger.label: 45 days after the Acme - Membership Expiration Date

filters: Acme - Is Active Member is lapsed
Acme - Subscription is blank or cancelled (not on auto-renew)
Acme - Membership Card Type is Primary
paths.action: Final invitation: the member's own price table, what members get, and a one-question reply survey on why not; Founding Members are reminded their recognition is permanent.

emails.subject: One last note about your membership
emails.preheader: Your level is still here when you want it, and one question.
notes: Someone on the membership team should own the replies to membership@trlibrary.com.
